subject: Has something changed recently (since Dec 2016) with deployments on Shinyapps.io ?

messages.author: 1667ac6354bdba89
messages.subject: Has something changed recently (since Dec 2016) with deployments on Shinyapps.io ?
parts:
Hello,

I'm getting bug reports for googleAuthR apps that started in the last month about Shiny apps that work locally but not on shinyapps.io - I wondered if there have been changes to the deploying docker container that may have affected this?

An example in this forum is here: https://groups.google.com/forum/?hl=en#!topic/shinyapps-users/lU-xS9Bk5FA
And an example github issue: https://github.com/MarkEdmondson1234/googleAuthR/issues/57

At the moment it looks as if options() are not being picked up, but I'd like to rule out anything else that may have happened, since it does seem to be Shinyapps.io specific.  Deploying on my local Shiny server works ok.

Yours sincerely,
Mark

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Has something changed recently (since Dec 2016) with deployments on Shinyapps.io ?
parts:
When deploying to shinyapps.io, we use the same version of R and the same package versions that are installed locally.

However, we do attempt to cache the built packages (this can be toggled off/on per application), and there was a recent instance of ggplot2 introducing a build time dependency by mistake which caused the cached ggiraph package to have problems, which was resolved by purging it from the cache to allow it be built against the fixed version of ggplot2. I mention that mainly because of meh256's comment in issue 59.

I can't think of a reason that options would have started behaving differently as of December, but I suppose for debugging one could set an option and then either render it or print it and view the logs to verify the value, which worked for me with:

options("googleAuthR.webapp.client_secret" = "something_something")
print(options("googleAuthR.webapp.client_secret"))

Let me know if you think of anything else to try, and I am happy to collaborate in real time to get to the bottom of this mystery.

messages.subject: Re: Has something changed recently (since Dec 2016) with deployments on Shinyapps.io ?
parts:
The built package is cached, but the user's code that sets the option is still run, so I really only think the package caching would come into play if there were a build time dependency that was not expressed in the DESCRIPTION.
The package cache for an application may be toggled on and off in the dashboard under Settings -> Advanced.
